partner.title: XePrime Partner app
partner.intro: Renting out on XePrime — listing your own car or opening a shop — happens in the XePrime Partner app, with a separate partner account. You can reuse the same phone number, with its own password.
partner.openFailed: Could not open XePrime Partner. If it is not installed yet, tap Get XePrime Partner.
partner.notAvailableTitle: This part lives in the XePrime app
partner.notAvailableDescription: XePrime Partner is for owners and shops. To find and rent vehicles, please use the XePrime app with a renter account.

intro.title: Rent out with XePrime Partner
intro.body: Turn an idle vehicle into income. Everything about renting out — listing, accepting trips, managing the calendar — happens in the XePrime Partner app.

account.title: Create a partner account
account.body: Partner accounts are separate from renter accounts. You can reuse your current phone number, just set a separate password.

choose.title: Choose how to rent out
choose.body: List a personal vehicle to start fast with no sign-up fee — or open a shop if you run several vehicles. Switching later keeps your vehicles and data.

publish.title: List a vehicle or open a shop
publish.body: Personal hosts: add details, pricing and photos, then submit for review. Shops: register the shop, then list the fleet. Once XePrime approves, vehicles go live.

partner.notInstalledBody: It looks like XePrime Partner isn’t installed. Download the app, then come back here to continue.
partner.comingSoonTitle: XePrime Partner is coming to the stores
partner.comingSoonBody: XePrime Partner isn’t on the App Store or Google Play yet. We’ll let you know as soon as it’s available.
